messages:
maya.k: Quick announce: on Sat 2026-07-10 00:00-01:30 UTC were switching CI runner identity to the Identity Gateway (id-gw). Goal: remove long-lived repo PATs and centralize machine identity.

sam.infra: Who needs to act? TL;DR would help.

maya.k: TL;DR:
- Runner owners: install runner-agent v0.9.4+ (token exchange support)
- Devs: remove hardcoded PATs from workflows, run preflight in `redwood-ci-staging` with CI_IDG_TEST=1
- Repo admins: expect org-level service-account invites; review mappings

nora.devex: Can devs get a sample repo and a checklist? Ill send the template to owners.

maya.k: Sample: `tools/ci-samples/runner-idg` and checklist in the migration doc: https://go.internal/ci-idg. Also a cleanup script to strip PATs.

sre-bot: Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m health checks. Monitoring knobs: `ci.auth.errors`, `runner.register.latency`, `workflow.fail.rate`.

sam.infra: Rollback? Immediate fallback available?

maya.k: Yes: we can re-enable Okta passthrough route for 30m while we patch. Rollback steps (kubectl + ingress) in runbook.

nora.devex: I'll coordinate a smoke test on Fri 16:00 UTC and collect results here.

maya.k: Action items recap: runners upgrade, devs test, repo admins verify mappings, security to audit tokens. Post blockers in thread and tag @sam.infra. :thumbsup:
